method: Individual painted edits from accepted sources. Saved source images are the reproducible input; image generation itself is nondeterministic. See build scripts for nearest reduction, registration and shared-palette grading.

entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production texture for UNDERCROFT, original forgotten-1993 dungeon crawler; painted, chunky handmade material clusters intended for nearest reduction to64x64 and a shared31-colour palette. Image1 is the geometry/material-density reference. Make FLOOR THREE: THE LOWER WATCH, an abandoned dry underground guard level. Distinct identity: charcoal soot in crevices, dry iron-grey and weathered umber/ochre, pale BONE ASH caught on chipped lower edges, scattered ancient iron/rust scars. NO teal, blue-green moss or wet turquoise. Dirty and aged, restrained highlights, low frontal warm lamplight, cool soot shadow. Full-bleed opaque square orthographic texture face, no room perspective, writing, labels, UI or watermark. Repaint this large FOUR-COURSE chipped abbey stone wall as old watch-post masonry. Preserve broad irregular stone sizes and course positions, but use charcoal/rust/bone-ochre dry material. A few old iron dowel holes are filled with rust and ash, broad soot brush scars in recesses. Pale dust grazes lower-front lips, slightly darker flatter stone faces, no speckled noise. No doors, slit openings or fixtures on this PLAIN repeatable wall. Keep edges seamless and uninterrupted masonry.
